$comment: Hand-curated vehicle families for the NAADAP knowledge base. Every value here traces to a source in `sources`; the build script (build_kb.py) attaches observed FPDS statistics and provenance and writes the shipped artifact. Regexes match hyphen-stripped, upper-cased parent PIIDs (the `parent_award_id_piid` / Referenced IDV PIID column). Dates are ISO; 'evergreen' means no ordering-period end; 'unknown' is a literal, never omitted. acquisition_path_tier follows derived requirement CORE-273: 1 order under an existing in-scope agency MAC/IDIQ (FAR 16.505(b)); 2 FSS/MAS order or BPA call (FAR 8.405); 3 GWAC or other-agency vehicle order (FAR 17.5, DFARS 217.770); 4 new IDIQ (FAR 16.504(c)); 5 new stand-alone contract.

families.name: SeaPort-NxG
families.scope_text: Engineering and program-management services for the Department of the Navy in 23 subject areas (Annex 22 functional areas): engineering, technical, and programmatic support including systems engineering, software engineering, test and evaluation, logistics, configuration management, program management, and related professional services. Task orders are competed among contract holders; approximately 85 percent of holders are small businesses. NMCARS 5237.102 requires consideration of SeaPort-NxG for services in its functional areas unless an exception applies.
eligible_ordering_activities: Department of the Navy ordering offices (106 offices in 10 commands), including NAVAIR and its warfare centers

families.name: NAWCAD SCI / Platform and Program Life-Cycle Support MAC (2025)
families.scope_text: Support services at multiple classification levels, up to and including top secret/sensitive compartmented information, to support all aspects of the acquisition life cycle for various platforms and programs within the NAVAIR Enterprise. Successor capability to the expired NAVAIR PM CSS MAC.
families.ordering_period_end_note: Catalog states five years from March 2025; month-end date is derived.
eligible_ordering_activities: NAVAIR enterprise (headquarters, PEOs/PMAs, warfare centers, FRCs)
socioeconomic_pools: small-business set-aside at order level (15 small primes)

families.name: NAWCTSD Training Systems Contract IV (TSC IV)
families.scope_text: Training system design, development, production, test and evaluation, delivery, modification, and support, including instructional systems development. NAICS 333318.

families.name: NAWCTSD Fielded Training Systems Support V (FTSS V)
families.vehicle_type: Multiple-award IDIQ (MAC), 9 primes (Lot 1 unrestricted D1001-D1007; Lot 2 small-business D2001-D2002)
families.scope_text: Contractor operation and maintenance services and contractor instructional services in support of fielded training systems.
families.ordering_period_end_note: Catalog states August 2030; month-end date is derived.

families.name: NAWCTSD Pilot and Aircrew Curriculum Revision and Maintenance (PACRM)
families.scope_text: Planned and unplanned revision and maintenance of pilot and aircrew curriculum for the U.S. Navy, U.S. Marine Corps, and foreign military sales customers. Curriculum content, not training systems or devices.

families.name: NAWCAD Cyber Warfare IDIQ
families.scope_text: Cyber warfare requirements and operations support for NAWCAD cyber departments.

families.name: GSA Multiple Award Schedule (Federal Supply Schedule)
families.vehicle_type: Federal Supply Schedule; orders under FAR 8.4
families.owner_name: General Services Administration, Federal Acquisition Service
families.scope_text: Commercial services and products by Special Item Number (SIN), including professional services, IT services and products, facilities, and logistics. Orders placed under FAR subpart 8.4; DFARS 217.770 applies to DoD use of non-DoD vehicles.
eligible_ordering_activities: All federal agencies; state and local for some SINs
socioeconomic_pools: by SIN and set-aside at order level

families.name: GSA OASIS+
families.vehicle_type: Multiple-award IDIQ, six socioeconomic families, 13 domains
families.owner_name: General Services Administration, Federal Acquisition Service
families.scope_text: Non-IT professional services across 13 domains (management and advisory, technical and engineering, research and development, logistics, and others); Best-in-Class under category management.
families.ordering_period_end_note: Catalog states five plus five years from 2024; base-period end is derived.
eligible_ordering_activities: Federal agencies with a delegation of procurement authority

families.name: NASA SEWP V (Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement)
families.scope_text: IT and audio-visual products and product-based services: hardware, software, networking equipment, and associated support. Best-in-Class under category management. SEWP VI begins ordering 1 November 2026.
eligible_ordering_activities: All federal agencies and approved contractors
socioeconomic_pools: by contract group, including small-business groups

families.name: NAVAIR headquarters Basic Ordering Agreements (per vendor)
families.vehicle_type: Basic Ordering Agreement (FAR 16.703), one per vendor; each order is a separately negotiated contract
families.scope_text: Vendor-specific agreements, predominantly with platform original equipment manufacturers, used for spares, repair, retrofit, and integrated logistics support orders. Not a multiple-award strategic vehicle: a BOA is not a contract, and each order under it is a new contract action.
eligible_ordering_activities: NAVAIR contracting offices named in each agreement

families.name: DON Enterprise Software License BPAs (NIWC Pacific)
families.vehicle_type: Blanket purchase agreements under Federal Supply Schedule contracts (DoD ESI / DON ESL)
families.scope_text: Commercial off-the-shelf software licensing and subscriptions under DoD Enterprise Software Initiative and DON Enterprise Software License agreements (observed in FY2025 NAVAIR orders: VMware, Azure, AutoCAD, Splunk, Creo, SAP). Mandatory consideration for DON software purchases.
